svg.title: Lena’s informed invitation
svg.text: Nelle Van Acker, I offer you a lasting place in my home in
Leuven’s Groot Begijnhof, not just a visit. I understand why you
need a new connection and that you will relinquish your former
address. I have room for your household to reunite here. — Lena
Vermeulen, fictional host; no real private address.
